context_summary: F59 is a batch of 5 independent bugfixes/polish items reported by the user: (1) Parallax background ends as player advances — mesh is static at origin, needs to follow camera; (2) Mel gets stuck on invisible colliders — non-solid blocks (leaf, water) create sensor colliders that interfere with ground detection; (3) Mobile touch controls appear but don't respond — only onTouchStart/End handlers, no onPointerDown/Up fallback; (4) Mobile browser header stays visible — missing viewport-fit=cover and 100dvh; (5) PWA install fails — service worker health check 404s on static deploy. All 5 are independent and can be parallelized in a single Wave.

options_considered.description: Plan all 5 fixes as independent tasks in a single Wave 0 for maximum parallelism. Each fix touches different files with zero overlap.
pros: All 5 fixes are completely independent — no shared state or file conflicts
Single Wave means fastest possible execution
Each fix is small and well-scoped with clear root cause already identified
Addresses critical mobile UX issues that block real user adoption
cons: No incremental testing between fixes (but they're independent so this is fine)

rationale: All 5 fixes are independent with no file overlap. Parallax touches ParallaxImageBackground.tsx, colliders touch Block.tsx/Mel.tsx, touch controls touch TouchControls3D.tsx, fullscreen touches index.html/CSS, and PWA touches sw.js/manifest.json. A single Wave 0 with all 5 tasks maximizes throughput. Root causes are already identified from investigation, making each fix well-scoped.
